scriptText:
I. SCREAMING AMBER WOOD (LIVE-ACTION)

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a dark fantasy cinematic scene featuring @actor1 as Rosa (voice: @audio1), a crowned princess clad in travel mantle, and @actor2 as Robert (voice: @audio2), her translucent spectral mentor, confronting each other within an ancient dormant grove.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Maintain 180-degree axis discipline with Rosa advancing toward the subterranean root fissure while Robert floats across her screen direction. Ensure persistent bioluminescent cyan footprint ripples on the frost floor, unbroken semi-transparency and cyan rim-lighting from Robert, and stable tracking of the silver thorn crown across all beats.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: 35mm dark fantasy film, fine grain, anamorphic falloff.
Palette: Midnight blue, petrified bone white, slate grey, bioluminescent cyan, molten amber.
Lighting: Chiaroscuro twilight, spectral cyan fill from Robert, intense golden underlighting from the subterranean fissure.
Location: Dormant primordial grove, petrified weeping trunks, reactive mycelial frost carpet, steaming root cavity.
Wardrobe: Rosa in textured charcoal wool tunic, silver thorn crown, tattered navy velvet mantle; Robert in distressed leather brigandine, rendered as a hovering translucent spirit with misty vapor trails.
Audio: Cavernous ambient hum, crisp crystalline footfalls, wind whistling through petrified hollows, viscous bubbling subterranean amber.
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
Full shot, eye level, camera positioned right of axis facing a circular clearing of petrified white weeping trees. Rosa stands midground in her navy velvet mantle and silver thorn crown, oriented left toward a glowing root fissure in the background, while the semi-translucent, glowing cyan spirit of Robert hovers at chest height beside her above the frost-covered floor.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM] FS, tracking backward ahead of Rosa -> [ACT] Rosa strides deliberately across the frost floor, sending rippling cyan bioluminescence outward from each boot step, as Robert drifts directly into her forward path -> Robert says (pleading) {Rosa, stop.} -> <Crisp crunch of frozen moss under heavy boots> -> Robert says {Look at the ridge. There’s smoke.} -> [ACT] Rosa continues marching forward without breaking her stride.
[CAM] MCU, side profile tracking Rosa -> [ACT] Rosa fixes her gaze ahead toward the warm glow of the root cavity -> Rosa says (curt, tight jaw) {I see it.} -> Robert says O.S. (strained) {Then why are you here?} -> <Deep subterranean vibration vibrating through the frozen earth> -> [ACT] Swirling frost mist curls past her shoulders as she presses forward.
[CAM] MS, reverse tracking looking past Rosa toward Robert -> [ACT] Robert glides backward through the cold air matching her walking pace, raising translucent hands in appeal -> Robert says (urgent) {Every minute here brings the fire closer to your mother’s gates.} -> <Faint ethereal hum trailing Robert's floating form> -> [ACT] Rosa marches steadily into the space he occupies without flinching.
[CAM] MS, low angle looking past Rosa's mantle toward Robert -> [ACT] Robert descends to eye level, hovering just above the bioluminescent frost directly in front of her -> Rosa says (controlled, tense) {I know what’s at stake, Robert.} -> Robert says (harsh whisper) {Then act like it.} -> <Heavy breath billowing in the freezing air> -> [ACT] Rosa walks straight through his spectral shoulder, breaking his misty outline.
[CAM] MCU, moving three-quarters profile -> [ACT] Rosa emerges through the cyan vapor of Robert's spirit, her mantle fluttering from the ethereal draft -> Robert says (exasperated) {I bought you this road.} -> Rosa says (bitter, sorrowful) {You threw yourself away.} -> <Soft rustle of heavy velvet over travel wool> -> [ACT] Her jaw tightens as she locks her sight onto the approaching root chasm.
[CAM] FS, wide orbital track maintaining axis -> [ACT] Robert sweeps across her line of sight in a wide arc of cyan mist, his spectral face tight with dread -> Robert says (booming resonance) {I cleared your path!} -> <Distant groan of petrified timber echoing> -> Robert says {Take the horses. Cross the border.} -> [ACT] Robert comes to a halt hovering rigidly beside the perimeter of the glowing root fissure.
[CAM] MS, high angle looking down at the fissure perimeter -> [ACT] Rosa halts at the lip of the split root cavity, molten amber light illuminating her face and silver crown from below -> Rosa says (resolute) {Not alone.} -> Robert says O.S. (desperate plea) {The old stories are a trap, Rosa.} -> <Rhythmic thrumming heat pulsing from the chasm floor> -> [ACT] Golden vapor billows around her boots as she stares into the depths.
[CAM] MS, slow tilt down facing Rosa by the glowing fissure -> [ACT] Robert drifts down to ground level beside the rim, while Rosa drops into a grounded kneel before the fiery opening -> Robert says (hushed, defeated) {Whatever is down there... leave it in the dirt.} -> Rosa says (quiet, unshakeable) {I’m bringing you back.} -> <Viscous bubbling of hot subterranean resin> -> [ACT] Rosa lowers her bare hand steadily into the golden amber radiance.
